sample.task:
[there would be dialogue in this story:]

(Yoimiya wakes up in her room. Time for the Irodori Festival. She takes a quick second to look at the mirror - her baby bump has gotten incredibly big for 7 months, a sign her quadruplets are getting bigger. After getting dressed, she notices that vision-holders from Mondstadt, Liyue, and even Sumeru have visited Inazuma - the archons of Anemo, Geo, and Dendro have also attended.)
sample.chosen:
Yoimiya stretched her arms above her head, feeling the gentle kicks of her unborn quadruplets. The Irodori Festival was just around the corner, and she couldn't help but feel a mix of excitement and nervousness. She glanced at the mirror, her eyes widening at the sight of her baby bump, which had grown significantly in the past few weeks.

"Wow, they're really getting big," she murmured to herself, a soft smile playing on her lips. She ran her fingers through her hair, trying to tame the unruly strands that seemed to have a mind of their own.

After getting dressed in a beautiful, flowing dress that accentuated her baby bump, Yoimiya made her way downstairs to join the rest of the family for breakfast. The aroma of freshly cooked food filled the air, and she couldn't help but feel grateful for the love and support that surrounded her.

As she sat down at the table, her husband Kazuma greeted her with a warm smile. "Good morning, my love. You look radiant today," he said, reaching across the table to hold her hand.

Yoimiya blushed, feeling a surge of love for the man who had stood by her side through thick and thin. "Thank you, Kazuma. I'm just so excited for the festival. I can't wait to see everyone," she replied, her eyes sparkling with anticipation.

Kazuma nodded, his gaze filled with pride and admiration. "I know you'll be amazing, Yoimiya. You always are," he said, squeezing her hand gently.

After breakfast, Yoimiya spent the morning preparing for the festival. She carefully selected the outfits she would wear for each day, making sure they were both comfortable and stylish. As she worked, she couldn't help but feel a sense of awe at the thought of all the vision-holders who would be attending.

Later that afternoon, as the sun began to set, Yoimiya and Kazuma made their way to the festival grounds. The air was filled with the sounds of laughter and music, and the smell of delicious food wafted through the air.

As they walked through the crowds, Yoimiya couldn't help but feel a sense of wonder at the sight of so many people from different nations coming together to celebrate. She spotted vision-holders from Mondstadt, Liyue, and even Sumeru, all dressed in their finest attire.

"Look, Kazuma! It's the archons of Anemo!" she exclaimed, pointing excitedly at the group of vision-holders.

Kazuma smiled, his eyes crinkling at the corners. "Yes, it seems like they're all here to celebrate with us," he said, taking her hand in his.

As the night wore on, Yoimiya and Kazuma danced and laughed with their friends and family, enjoying every moment of the magical festival. And as they looked up at the starry sky above, they knew that no matter what challenges lay ahead, they would face them together, as a family.
